description:
2023 Subaru Outback Premium CVT — 2.5L H-4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, variable valve control, regular unleaded, 182 HP with 8-speed Lineartronic CVT. This Outback delivers a balanced blend of everyday practicality and confidence-inspiring capability, with recent pricing adjustments making it an appealing choice for shoppers seeking comfort, safety, and utility in one versatile wagon-like crossover.

The 2.5L boxer engine and Lineartronic CVT work together to provide smooth acceleration and steady highway cruising while helping preserve fuel economy for daily commutes and longer trips. The Premium trim brings a mix of comfort and convenience features that enhance life on the road without unnecessary complexity — a nice midpoint for drivers who want more than basic functionality but prefer to avoid extra frills.

Safety and driver-assist systems are a clear highlight. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go takes the stress out of congested highways by maintaining distance and bringing the vehicle to a stop and back to pace as traffic moves. Lane departure prevention and hands-on steering assist/lane centering help you stay confidently between the lines, gently correcting course and reducing fatigue on long stretches. Predictive brake assist and forward collision mitigation add proactive protection by readying brakes and applying interventions when a rapid slowdown is detected, while front pedestrian impact prevention increases awareness for people crossing in front of the vehicle. Together, these systems create a layered safety approach that watches the road so you can relax a bit more behind the wheel.

Practical touches make everyday life easier. The rear camera with washer keeps your rearview image clear in messy weather or when hauling gear, improving visibility while backing up. Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls lets you make speed adjustments without taking your hands off the wheel, keeping focus on the drive and reducing driver strain over long trips. Selective Internet access provides tailored connectivity options so you get the news, weather, or services you care about without clutter.

Inside, the Outback Premium balances comfort and functionality. Thoughtful ergonomics and convenient controls help make commutes and errands feel less taxing, while cargo versatility supports weekend adventures, whether that’s bikes, camping gear, or grocery runs. Subaru’s reputation for durable all-weather performance and sensible packaging continues to appeal to buyers who want capability without compromise.

Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage your music without taking your hands off the wheel.

Connectivity is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, giving you access to your favorite apps and navigation directly from the 6-speaker AM/FM/MP3/HD audio system. description: *2017 Subaru Impreza 2.0i Sport 5-door CVT* 2.0L H 4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, variable valve control with 152 HP and 7 speed Lineartronic CVT. This practical hatchback blends Subaru’s signature all wheel capability with thoughtful tech and comfort features to make daily driving more confident and enjoyable.Built around a smooth Flat 4 engine and a fuel efficient continuously variable transmission, the Impreza 2.0i Sport balances responsive passing power with sensible fuel use. The horizontally opposed engine layout helps lower the center of gravity, improving stability and handling feel. Variable valve timing and gasoline direct injection work together to refine performance and economy so the car feels lively when you want it to and efficient when you don’t.Inside, a user-friendly touchscreen brings key controls together where they’re easy to reach, cutting clutter and making infotainment interactions simpler while you drive. Smart device mirroring extends that convenience by letting you access favorite apps and navigation directly through the vehicle’s display, reducing the need to handle your phone and helping you stay focused on the road. A rear camera adds another layer of confidence when reversing or parking by giving a clear view of obstacles behind the vehicle.Comfort is prioritized with heated driver and front passenger seat cushions, delivering quick warmth on chilly mornings and easing lower back discomfort on long trips. Cruise control with steering wheel controls makes highway driving less fatiguing: set your pace and manage it without taking your hands off the wheel, improving comfort and potentially helping fuel efficiency on longer runs.Safety and stopping power are supported by brake assist, which detects panic braking and applies maximum braking force when needed to shorten stopping distance in emergencies. And because this Impreza is equipped with all wheel drive, you get better traction in wet or slippery conditions a big advantage for anyone living where weather can change quickly. The full time AWD setup constantly distributes power between front and rear axles so the car maintains grip without driver intervention.Overall, the 2017 Subaru Impreza 2.0i Sport 5 door CVT presents a well rounded package for buyers seeking a practical, reliable hatchback with enhanced traction, sensible tech, and creature comforts that matter every day. It’s a smart choice for commuters, small families, and anyone who wants Subaru’s capability in a compact, easy to live with format.

Trip computer, outside temperature display, and illuminated entry add practical functionality.

The 2017 Soul Plus combines sensible design with the features buyers value for commuting, local errands, and weekend drives. We invite you to inspect this Soul Plus and confirm it meets your transportation needs.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Combining Honda's proven engine with expansive interior views and ample cargo space, this Civic delivers a level of practicality and driving character that consistently ranks among the best in its class. It's a genuinely willing engine, delivering confident, responsive acceleration for everyday driving. Honda's intuitive control layout keeps core functions within easy reach without pulling attention from the road. SAFETY FEATURES Honda Sensing brings a comprehensive suite of standard driver-assist technology, including collision mitigation braking, lane keeping assist, adaptive cruise control, and road departure mitigation, working continuously in the background to provide confident, predictable handling. Traffic sign recognition and a driver attention monitor round out a genuinely comprehensive safety package. ... and there's SO MUCH more! That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Performance features focus on efficiency and responsiveness, starting with auto start/stop technology that conserves fuel during stops. The hybrid system relies on a lithium-ion battery for reliable power and energy regeneration, contributing to the vehicle’s impressive fuel economy. These features work together to deliver a smooth, efficient drive while maintaining the performance expectations of a modern hybrid vehicle.

The refined interior showcases fine Nappa leather seating surfaces complemented by leatherette center console and door armrests, while the sport steering wheel and leather shift knob add purposeful touches. Entertainment options include SiriusXM satellite radio, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration, and the premium audio quality that has made Bang & Olufsen synonymous with sonic excellence.

With 41,565 miles, this well-maintained S5 remains in excellent condition and ready for years of enjoyable driving. The combination of performance-oriented engineering, intuitive technology, and premium materials makes this vehicle a standout choice for those who appreciate quality and capability.

With 86,982 miles on the odometer, this Leaf has been well-maintained and remains a dependable choice for buyers seeking proven electric vehicle ownership. The combination of practical features, safety equipment, and genuine efficiency makes this an intelligent vehicle to consider.

This 2015 Ford Fiesta SE offers practical economy and reliability in a compact package that's ready for your daily commute and weekend adventures.

- 6-Speed Automatic (PowerShift) transmission with SelectShift capability
- 1.6L I-4 Ti-VCT engine with 28 city/36 highway MPG
- 16" Black Machined wheels with P195/50R16 tires
- Keyless-Entry Keypad for convenient access
- Remote Start System for comfort in any season
- AM/FM Stereo with CD player and MP3 capability
- Air Conditioning with rear window defroster
- Power steering with speed-sensing adjustment
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee airbag
- Unique cloth front bucket seats with split-folding rear seat
- Front Center Armrest for added comfort
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls
- Trip computer and compass display

The Fiesta SE combines fuel efficiency with a responsive driving experience. The 1.6-liter engine delivers solid performance while maintaining impressive fuel economy, making it an excellent choice for budget-conscious drivers. The 6-speed automatic transmission performs smoothly and includes SelectShift for those moments when you want more control.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin with cloth bucket seats and thoughtful convenience features. The keyless-entry keypad and remote start system add modern touches that enhance daily driving. Audio entertainment comes from an AM/FM stereo with CD player and MP3 capability, complemented by steering wheel controls for safe operation.

Safety is prioritized with electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front, front side, and knee airbags. The independent front suspension and front anti-roll bar contribute to confident handling in various driving conditions.

The exterior Black finish is complemented by body-color bumpers and the distinctive 16-inch black machined wheels. Automatic headlights, rear window wipers, and a rear spoiler round out the practical design that balances style with functionality.

With 72,551 miles, this Fiesta SE has demonstrated reliability and represents an excellent value in the used compact car market. Visit our showroom today to see this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive.

Tonkin Value Car!!!!

This 2014 Fiat 500e Battery Electric combines practicality with eco-conscious driving, offering a compact vehicle designed for daily commuting and city navigation with minimal environmental impact.

- 122 City MPGe / 108 Highway MPGe
- Electric Motor with Single Speed transmission
- Leatherette Heated Bucket Seats
- Automatic Temperature Control
- TomTom Navigation System
- SiriusXM Radio Service (1-Year)
- Rear Parking Sensors
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Heated Front Seats
- Front Fog Lights
- Anti-Whiplash Front Head Restraints
- Dual Front Impact Airbags
- Split Folding Rear Seat
- 15" Cast Aluminum Wheels with Orange Mirror Cap
- Security System

The 500e delivers impressive fuel efficiency with city ratings reaching 122 MPGe and highway performance at 108 MPGe, making it an economical choice for regular drivers. The electric motor provides reliable performance with smooth acceleration suitable for urban environments and highway travel.

Comfort features include leatherette heated bucket seats and automatic temperature control to maintain your preferred climate regardless of season. The tilt steering wheel and steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to customize your driving position and manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The TomTom navigation system helps you navigate unfamiliar routes confidently.

Safety is prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to provide confident handling in various driving conditions. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS offer reliable stopping power, and rear parking sensors assist when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Exterior styling features the distinctive eSport Package with orange mirror caps, body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and 15" cast aluminum wheels that give the vehicle a refined appearance. Front fog lights enhance visibility during low-light conditions, while heated power door mirrors with auto-dimming capability improve safety and convenience.

The compact design and efficient powertrain make this 500e an excellent option for environmentally conscious buyers seeking a practical, well-equipped vehicle for everyday use. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this distinctive electric vehicle firsthand.

The Prius Plug-in combines a 1.8L 4-Cylinder DOHC engine with hybrid efficiency, achieving 51 MPGe in city driving and 49 MPGe on the highway. This powertrain delivers reliable performance while minimizing fuel costs and environmental impact. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides stable handling in various driving conditions, and the continuously variable transmission ensures smooth acceleration without traditional gear shifts.

Interior comfort and convenience features make daily driving more enjoyable. Heated front bucket seats provide warmth during cooler months, while the automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin climate. The navigation system helps you reach your destination with confidence, and steering wheel-mounted controls for audio and climate functions keep your attention on the road. Illuminated entry and overhead console lighting enhance visibility when entering the vehicle.

Safety has been engineered throughout this model. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and knee airbags positioned to protect occupants in various collision scenarios. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip and stability, while anti-whiplash front head restraints and anti-roll bars provide additional protection. The 4-wheel disc braking system with ABS ensures confident stopping power in all conditions.

Practical storage and visibility features round out the package. The rear parking camera assists with backing up safely, variably intermittent wipers adapt to rainfall, and the rear window wiper clears the back glass for full visibility. Split folding rear seats offer flexibility for cargo or passengers, while door bins and an underseat storage armrest provide convenient spaces for personal items.

The four-wheel independent suspension handles curves and uneven surfaces smoothly.

Technology and convenience are woven throughout. The AM/FM/SiriusXM/CD/MP3 audio system delivers clear sound through multiple speakers, while trip computer functions keep you informed. Speed control, power steering, and telescoping steering wheel all enhance everyday usability.

This 2014 BMW i3 Range Extender is exactly the kind of early i3 that shows why BMW s first dedicated electric car has developed such a following. Finished in Ionic Silver Metallic with BMW i Frozen Blue accents, it has the unmistakable look BMW created specifically for the i division futuristic without trying to imitate anything else in the lineup, and still immediately recognizable more than a decade later.

Inside, this example is equipped with the desirable Giga World interior featuring Cassia Natural Leather paired with Carum Spice Grey Wool Cloth. It is one of the combinations that made the i3 cabin so distinctive in the first place, mixing premium materials with the lighter, more architectural design philosophy BMW used throughout the car. Rather than feeling like a conventional BMW interior with an electric drivetrain underneath it, the i3 was designed from the ground up to feel different.

This example is also nicely optioned with the Technology + Driving Assistant Package, Giga World, heated front seats and DC Fast Charging capability. The additional technology equipment makes this a particularly attractive configuration for someone who wants more than a basic commuter-spec i3, while DC Fast Charging adds another level of everyday usability for an early-generation EV.

The engineering underneath the i3 is arguably even more interesting than its design. BMW developed the car around a carbon-fiber-reinforced passenger cell, an aluminum chassis and a rear-mounted electric motor driving the rear wheels. That lightweight construction was extraordinarily ambitious for a mass-produced vehicle at the time and remains unusual today outside considerably more expensive performance and exotic cars.

This is the Range Extender version, meaning the electric drivetrain is supplemented by BMW s compact gasoline generator when additional range is needed. The wheels remain electrically driven, preserving the immediate throttle response and smoothness of an EV while giving the driver additional flexibility beyond the battery-only version.

BMW also gave the i3 legitimate BMW character. With its rear-wheel-drive layout, low-mounted battery and compact dimensions, it feels light and responsive around town rather than heavy and isolated. The tall greenhouse provides excellent visibility, the compact exterior makes parking easy, and the rear-hinged rear doors and upright cabin design make surprisingly efficient use of the available space.

The i3 has also become increasingly interesting from an enthusiast and design perspective. BMW spent enormous resources creating a dedicated carbon-fiber EV platform at a time when most manufacturers were still experimenting with electrification. Very few vehicles before or since have combined this level of unconventional construction, design and engineering in a compact production car.

For someone looking for a used BMW i3 Range Extender in Sacramento, this Ionic Silver Metallic example stands out with its Giga World leather-and-wool interior, Technology + Driving Assistant Package, heated seats and DC Fast Charging. description:
You're looking at a 2014 Mazda Mazda3 s Grand Touring finished in striking Soul Red Metallic that commands attention on the road. This sedan combines proven reliability with the refinement you expect from a Grand Touring model, offering a compelling package for buyers seeking dependable daily transportation.

- SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L 4-Cylinder engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Front dual zone automatic climate control
- Heated reclining front bucket seats with perforated leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Navigation system with exterior parking camera
- Heads-up display
- Bi-xenon HID headlights with front fog lights
- 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- 18-inch alloy wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Leather shift knob
- Rain sensing wipers

The interior welcomes you with heated front bucket seats upholstered in perforated leather, complemented by a power moonroof that floods the cabin with natural light. Climate control is managed through dual-zone automatic temperature control, ensuring comfort for all occupants. You'll find convenient features like the leather shift knob, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, and an overhead console with trip computer that keeps you informed during every drive.

Technology is well-represented here with a navigation system guiding your route, a heads-up display keeping vital information in your line of sight, and remote keyless entry simplifying access. The audio system delivers nine speakers throughout the cabin, offering SiriusXM satellite radio alongside the standard AM/FM/CD capability. The exterior parking camera provides added confidence when reversing into tight spaces.

Safety receives appropriate attention with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes work together to help maintain vehicle control in demanding conditions. Four-wheel independent suspension with both front and rear anti-roll bars supports responsive handling and ride quality.

Performance is handled by the SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L 4-cylinder engine delivering 27 city MPG and 37 highway MPG through the efficient 6-speed automatic transmission. This powerplant balances capability with fuel economy, making it practical for both urban commuting and longer highway journeys.

The exterior showcases Soul Red Metallic paint that deepens in sunlight, complemented by bi-xenon HID headlights with integrated fog lights that cut through poor visibility. Power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, a body-color spoiler, and 18-inch alloy wheels complete a cohesive, modern appearance. Heated door mirrors clear fog and ice quickly during colder months, while rain sensing wipers automatically adjust to changing weather conditions.

This Mazda3 s Grand Touring represents solid value for buyers seeking a well-equipped sedan with proven engineering. We invite you to schedule a time to view this vehicle in person and experience its comfort and capability firsthand.

2023 Ram ProMaster Overview
Thanks to the most vertically oriented side panels in the industry, which help to maximize interior space, the ProMaster offers best-in-class cargo capacity. This ProMaster comes with a sliding passenger-side door and 2 rear doors that open 260 degrees, swinging all the way back to the sides of the vehicle, making it easy to back up to loading docks. All 3 openings are large enough for a forklift to load and unload pallets in the vehicle, and the ProMaster can carry full 4x8 sheets of plywood. A low 21-inch step-in height, resulting from the front-wheel-drive configuration and another best-in-class feature, makes it easy to load and unload cargo. Designed for business and commercial use in North America, the rugged, highly customizable Ram ProMaster cargo van debuted in 2014 with a number of best-in-class features. Based on the European FIAT Ducato van, which has been around for decades, and the latest vehicle resulting from the collaboration of the Italian automaker and Chrysler. This 2023 Ram ProMaster holds the distinction as the only vehicle in its class with front-wheel drive. This provides a number of benefits including reduced overall weight, fewer mechanical parts, more efficient operation, a low step-in height and improved traction on snowy, icy and gravel roads. In addition, the front-wheel-drive configuration eliminates the transmission hump between the seats, resulting in a flat cargo floor. This High Roof Pro Master measures 101 inches high & 250 inches long. Unibody construction helps to reduce weight and improve overall efficiency and economy, while a rigid ladder-bar chassis with 8 cross-members and a welded floor panel ensures overall stiffness and durability. The ProMaster offers a payload capacity of up to 5,145 pounds and has a maximum towing capacity of 5,100 pounds. Standard 4-wheel Brembo disc brakes provide good stopping power, while a 36-foot turning radius, again a best-in-class feature, helps make the ProMaster maneuverable in urban environments and tight spaces.

This Promaster has a gas 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 that puts out 280 hp and 260 lb-ft of torque, and mates to a 62TE 6-speed automatic transmission tuned for heavy payloads.

Outside, the ProMaster displays a functional design, with a modular front end designed for easy repairs and high-mounted headlights. The large flat side panels are ideal for signage and traveling billboards, Ram notes. The ProMaster borrows some of its front fascia components from the Ducato but also displays Ram's distinctive hexagon-shaped crosshair grille with the Ram logo planted front and center.

Inside, the driver sits high, resulting in good visibility out the front. In designing the cabin, Ram emphasized ergonomics, comfort and function. Buyers can add an optional driver's suspension seat, as well as swivel seats for the driver and passenger. Ram equips the ProMaster with Chrysler's Uconnect system, which enables hands-free calling and text replies via Bluetooth. The Uconnect system includes a 5-inch color touchscreen and GPS navigation, designed to help businesses operate more efficiently.

Standard safety features for the ProMaster include 6 airbags and electronic stability control with trailer-sway control, as well as traction control, antilock brakes and hill-start assist. A ParkView backup camera and ParkSense with an audible warning assist drivers in maneuvering the van. In all, the ProMaster comes with 35 safety and security features.

Competitors to the ProMaster include the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, the new Ford Transit and the Nissan NV Cargo, as well as the Ford Econoline and Chevrolet Express/GMC Savanna.
